maria.g: Quick check — planning canary for `flag:new-routing-optimizer` today. Proposed rollout: 1% -> 5% after 12h -> 20% after 48h. Any objections on guardrails? cc @kevin.c @devon

kevin.c: Sounds fine. Couple questions: what's our primary metric for stopping? latency P95 or errors?

maria.g: Primary is P95 tail latency (route latency), secondary is 5xx rate. If P95 > +25% from baseline for 30m we stop. 5xx > 0.5% absolute also abort.

devon: Are those thresholds global or per-region? We saw region spikes last month.

ashley: per-region please. We should avoid killing a global rollout for a single noisy region. Can we make the guardrail per-region + an aggregate check?

maria.g: Yep — plan is per-region checks + cluster-level aggregate. I'll post the rollout config in a sec.

rollout-bot: [incoming] Draft rollout config for flag:new-routing-optimizer by maria.g

maria.g: ```json
{
  "flag": "new-routing-optimizer",
  "stages": [
    {"pct": 1, "duration": "12h"},
    {"pct": 5, "duration": "36h"},
    {"pct": 20, "duration": "48h"}
  ],
  "guardrails": {
    "per_region": {"p95_increase_pct": 25, "error_rate_abs": 0.005, "window": "30m"},
    "global": {"p95_increase_pct": 40, "error_rate_abs": 0.01, "window": "30m"}
  },
  "audience": "hash:user_id:v2",
  "breakglass": "oncall/sre"
}
```

kevin.c: Two notes: 1) audience hash should include traffic source so web/mobile get consistent buckets. use `hash:user_id:platform:v1`. 2) add a metric for model-regression (responses_per_request) — we need to watch quality regressions.

maria.g: Good call. I'll change audience and add a quality signal (avg_tokens_per_response + unexpected_nulls).

devon: For sampling: Are we using uniform random or deterministic hash? Deterministic is needed for A/B continuity.

maria.g: Deterministic via our bucketing service. Config snippet: `audience: bucketer("user_id","platform", 10000)` so 1% = first 100 of 10000.

ashley: For metrics: I'll pin the exact SQL for reviewers. Use this to compute per-region p95 and error rate:
```
SELECT region, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) as p95, sum(is_5xx)::float / count(*) as error_rate
FROM http_logs
WHERE flag = 'new-routing-optimizer'
  AND time >= now() - interval '30 minutes'
GROUP BY region;
```

maria.g: Nice. Also note the experiment window for comparison: take baseline from last 7 days same hour-of-day to control diurnal traffic.

kevin.c: Stopping rule wording for the UI: "Abort rollout if per-region p95 increases >25% vs baseline (30m window) OR 5xx rate increases >0.5% absolute." Keep it explicit.

maria.g: I'll add that exact text to the rollout ticket and ping QA.

devon: One more: how do we handle users who flip between web/mobile during the test? With platform in hash we might split them. Do we care?

ashley: Ideally we want sticky across devices if user_id exists. If user_id missing, fallback to device-cookie which can be noisy. Add a note: prefer user_id, then account_id, then device fallback.

maria.g: Added. Also requesting quick CR on the feature flag code: @kevin.c can you glance at PR #4521? small change to bucketer call.

kevin.c: Will review in ~30m.

metrics-bot: Metric job scheduled: p95 and error_rate dashboards will update every 5 minutes during rollout window. Alerts configured for guardrails.

maria.g: Thanks. If we have no objections by +1h I'll kick it off. :rocket: 

ashley: +1 from infra and analytics side.

devon: +1, sres asked for an escape hatch doc. I'll drop runbook link in the ticket.

kevin.c: Reviewed PR, left one nit about logging. otherwise LGTM.

maria.g: Awesome — starting canary at 1765432500. I'll post updates here.

rollout-bot: Rollout started: flag:new-routing-optimizer at 1% (stage 1). Initiated by maria.g at 1765432500.

maria.g: First 15m check — no anomalies.

ashley: saw slight p95 blip in eu-west but within baseline noise. continuing monitoring.

maria.g: If anything crosses guardrail call abort and notify #incidents.

kevin.c: Copy.

devon: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollout-abort-2024

maria.g: Thanks team, will update after 12h when we evaluate for 5% bump.
